value.answer: Call 911 now - your child is floppy and drowsy after a seizure with a fever, and that needs emergency care. Lay them on their side on a safe surface, put nothing in their mouth, and stay with them.
value.triage: Do not wait to see if they perk up; go to the ER by ambulance. Tell 911 right away if they turn blue, struggle to breathe, or seize again. Health811 (811) is for nurse advice later, not for this.
